name: Aisu Vanilla
source:
Princess of the Magical World, daughter of Candy.

Vanilla is a cute and petite girl with short, curly blonde hair, large purple eyes, and small fangs and pointy ears like all Le Royaume.

She cries a lot (which attracts boys), is very kind and gentle and has a very soft voice. Despite having totally opposite characteristics, she is close to her childhood friend Chocolat.
